title: Nobody pays for open source. We can force them to. | Seldo.com
description: Thirty years of voluntary funding schemes haven't paid open source maintainers because asking doesn't scale. The real money already flows — to JFrog, Docker, Sonatype — at the registry layer. The fix: registries charge companies for supply (they already do), then route a slice automatically to the maintainers who make that supply worth having.
comment: Using the package registries as common ground between OS maintainer and OS user to require payment and transfer them to the OS maintainer. Could work
